overview: VeriScan is a polished frontend prototype for an AI-powered identity and document screening platform, with a landing page, dashboard, upload flow, verification results, reports, and settings.
features: Landing page with hero, features, how-it-works, CTA, and footer
Dashboard with statistics cards, recent documents, and sidebar navigation
Drag-and-drop upload flow with fake progress animation and file preview
Verification result page with status, confidence score, extracted info, and AI analysis cards
Reports page with searchable and filterable verification table
Settings page with profile, theme toggle, and notification settings
